name: Amazon Now
description: Amazon Now is Amazon India's quick-commerce business unit, operated under Amazon's India entities (Amazon Seller Services) with no separate listed/registered entity broken out. Ultimate parent Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ: AMZN).

stock.note: No standalone entity; reflects parent Amazon.com Inc ~$262.07 (Aug 25, 2026).

marketing_spend.derivation: No standalone financials, so Tiers 1-3 are constrained. PMAR 2026 fully folded quick-commerce AdEx into its expanded ₹1.55 lakh crore market total. Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart dominate q-commerce share-of-voice; Amazon Now is a late (2025) entrant with lower visibility (~5-10% of category marketing). Against category leaders each spending hundreds of crores, this triangulates to ~₹100-300 crore for FY26 — a rough, low-confidence launch-phase estimate.

business_updates.headline: Plans to scale to 300 cities 'very soon'; ~30 cities as of Sept 1, 2026
100+ Urban Fulfilment Centres planned to add apparel/electronics to the minutes-delivery network
Prime members reported to triple shopping frequency after adopting Amazon Now
